top_choice_rationale: P004 most persuasively recognizes a mature, tightly bounded programme showing how technological change and trade shocks reshape local labour markets and wage inequality, with a coherent three-person attribution and a citation that avoids claiming a complete causal account of labour-market change.
recusal_note: Jan Teorell was formerly at Lund University; the supplied profile records no direct research collaboration or other conflict involving him. No connection to the proposed B009 laureates is apparent from the supplied profile.
